sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear colleagues at Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.,

Thank you for your quote and for explaining your position.

Your defect rate over the last four quarters stands at 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). Our demand forecast for this part has changed +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).

We have analysed the cost situation of this part carefully; the options below reflect that analysis.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 43.78 per unit, quality commitment 300 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.
Option B: EUR 43.55 per unit, quality commitment 800 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.
Option C: EUR 43.24 per unit, quality commitment 1500 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We look forward to your view on these options.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Hi there, thanks for the numbers on volume and quality, we checked them. As to the quality record and volume change data you cited, we see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. 

Our offer is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. We can also suggest an alternative option: a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. We can do the 1500 ppm target, but your prices are way too low, so we can offer €46.00 per unit. 

The guys from the office will send you the cost breakdown later. Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.body:
Dear colleagues at Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.,

Thank you for your message and for telling us what matters to you.

German producer prices for electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

We are ready to move on the terms you care about if the price reflects it - each option below is a different trade, so you can choose what helps you most.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 44.44 per unit, EUR 500 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 300 ppm.
Option B: EUR 44.30 per unit, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 300 ppm.
Option C: EUR 44.34 per unit, EUR 150 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 300 ppm.

Could you send us the 8D report with root cause and containment for the recent complaints?

Please tell us which option suits you best.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
